name: fenceAndCommitKeyDamage
covers: fence damage plus commit-key damage: a collection pass meets the unparsable fence, the commit key is damaged under it, and the recovery exit replaces the unparsable fence and marks over the damaged key

labels.GC pass: read commit key, mark, read fen: g: open, gc: the gate refuses because the fence cannot be understood
labels.ENV: commit key DAMAGED (silent): environment step damage-commit, after g's read of the fence
labels.recovery exit: fence read unparsable, li: r: open, then recover once the damage is applied
